assessment: Final source review caught an accessibility regression in the first focus repair: an explicit history opening inherited field-restoration preventScroll=true. The heading could receive focus without natural scrolling into view. This is a new local review finding, not a reported hosted failure.

counterfactual.expected: Explicit history focus uses native scrolling.

correction: Retain a per-request scrolling intent: explicit history focus uses preventScroll=false; background restoration defaults to true. Preserve ownership/no-steal checks. Add a native browser in-viewport assertion after the existing focus assertion.
